claim: Patchline ships a prospective power analysis fixing sample sizes before any outcome is observed. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the prospective power analysis claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make prospective-power-analysis-gate`.
